acceptanceCriteria.description: Post-login redirect routes Stall Client to Dashboard (Image 1) or first-time setup (Image 2)
Dashboard matches Image 1 header, hero card, 2x2 action grid, support banner, and bottom dock
Tapping Billing or + Add Order navigates directly to Billing & Menu POS (Image 2)
Billing POS matches Image 2: left category sidebar and 2-column food dish grid
Dishes display floating price badge bottom-left and floating + button bottom-right of image
Tapping + adds item to cart and converts button into [-] [qty] [+] stepper
Floating bottom cart pill displays live item count and integer paise total
First-time clients or Settings users can write section names and add/edit dishes with prices and photos
Back arrow on Billing POS returns to Dashboard cleanly
Zero TypeScript errors and all 272 unit tests passing
